notes: Legislative Law Article 1-A (LOBBYING ACT) expands into 22 per-section leaf URLs, sections 1-A through 1-V, covering registration (1-E/1-F), reports (1-H through 1-L), gift/contact restrictions (1-M/1-N), penalties and enforcement (1-O/1-P), and disclosure/access (1-Q/1-S). All are core lobbying-disclosure provisions. This is the canonical section-leaf-bearing path, contrasted with the rla/ single-page stub.
